outcomes.statement: IBM's 15 Sep 2020 roadmap targeted concurrent real-time classical compute capabilities with Eagle in the following year; the 10 May 2022 roadmap still described dynamic circuits, which it defines as feedback and feedforward of quantum measurements, as something it would add.

evidence.quote: With the Eagle processor, we will also introduce concurrent real-time classical compute capabilities that will allow for execution of a broader family of quantum circuits and codes.

outcomes.statement: IBM's 10 May 2022 roadmap targeted introducing error mitigation and suppression techniques into Qiskit Runtime in 2024 and 2025; a 9 Nov 2022 release describes a beta option to trade speed for reduced error count, and the 13 Nov 2024 post describes two-level system mitigation on the processor.

evidence.quote: In 2024 and 2025, we’ll introduce error mitigation and suppression techniques into Qiskit Runtime so that users can focus on improving the quality of the results obtained from quantum hardware.
